title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: §46 of 'variations sur l'équation des lacets'. Let Ĝ_{0,3} be a profinite group generated by elements ρ and σ. These are presumably torsion elements of orders 3 and 2, so that Ĝ_{0,3} is a profinite completion of a group like PSL(2,Z) or SL(2,Z), the 'cartographic' group. Π̂_{0,3} is the profinite fundamental group of P^1 minus {0,1,∞}, sitting inside Ĝ_{0,3}. M^{!~}_{0,3} is a group of (outer) automorphisms, and S_0M^{!~}_{0,3} is the set of pairs (u,f). The previous page explicitly describes these pairs by triples (α,β,f) with α in Π̂^{~}, β,f in Π̂. The triples are subject to the 'loop relation' (17): αρ(α)^{-1} = βσ(β)^{-1}E_1(μ−1). Here ρ(α) denotes conjugation of α by ρ, and μ in Ẑ^* is a cyclotomic-character-like invariant determined by α.

On this page:
(20) defines the automorphism u_{α,β} by u(ρ)=ξρ and u(σ)=ησ, with ξ=αρ(α)^{-1} and η=βσ(β)^{-1}. Thus u sends ρ to αρα^{-1} and σ to βσβ^{-1}, up to the correction E_1(μ−1). Grothendieck notes that η is determined by ξ through (17), with μ=μ(ξ).
(21) twists by an inner automorphism: u_{α,β,f} = int(f^{-1}) u_{α,β}.
(22) the triple (α,β,f) gives the element (u_{α,β,f}, f) of S_0M^{!~}_{0,3}.
(23) defines a 'linearization' map from S_0M^{!~}_{0,3} to SM_{ρ,σ}(Ẑ)'. The map reduces α, β, f to their images α̲, β̲, f̲ in (S/G)L(2,Ẑ) modulo ±1, keeping μ and the sign ε_2(μ). The target SM_{ρ,σ}(Ẑ)' is the set of systems (α̲,β̲,μ,ε,f̲) in GL(2,Ẑ)^{±}×SL(2,Ẑ)'×Ẑ^××{±1}×SL(2,Ẑ)'. These must satisfy the linear analogue (24) of the loop equation, α̲ρ(α̲)^{-1} = ε β̲σ(β̲)^{-1} ε_1(μ−1), computed in GL(2,Ẑ) and not in the quotient mod ±1. Grothendieck remarks that this is independent of the choice of lifts.

Purpose: to compare the profinite GT-type group defined by the loop equation with its image in the congruence (linear, SL_2(Ẑ)) quotient. The next page checks that the restriction to the subgroup M^{!~}_{0,3}[0] (f=1) is a homomorphism into SG^{±}_{ρ,σ}, using the cocycle composition rules α''=u'(α)α' and β''=u'(β)β'.
errors: No genuine mathematical error is visible. In (23) the expression 'α̲ρ(α̲ρ)^{-1}' as transcribed is a misreading; it should be α̲ρ(α̲)^{-1}, consistent with (19) and (24).

Notation is fluid on this page: SG^* versus SG^±, GL versus SL, and the primed quotients mod ±1. The compatibility of the full map (23) with the twisted composition law, for f≠1, is only asserted here and is checked on the next page only for f=1.

ideas.what: Parametrization of automorphisms of the profinite cartographic group by pairs (α,β), with u(ρ)=αρα^{-1}, u(σ)=βσβ^{-1}(·power), subject to a loop equation involving μ∈Ẑ^*
ideas.modern_name: Grothendieck–Teichmüller group description, with GT elements given by (λ,f) satisfying the 2-cycle and 3-cycle relations
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme only sketches the idea of the 'Teichmüller tower' and the action on Ĝ_{0,3}; this explicit form is unpublished

ideas.what: Twisting by inner automorphisms int(f^{-1}) to pass from M[0] (normalizer of L_0) to the full set S_0M
ideas.modern_name: Outer versus inner automorphism lifts; the GT action on braid or cartographic groups up to inner automorphisms

ideas.what: Linearization: map from the GT-like group to a group SM_{ρ,σ}(Ẑ) defined by the loop equation in GL(2,Ẑ), with an ad hoc composition law
ideas.modern_name: Action of GT (or of Gal(Q̄/Q)) on the congruence completion SL_2(Ẑ); reduction through the cyclotomic character
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ihara, Nakamura, Lochak–Schneps (folklore that this action factors essentially through Ẑ^*)

missed.claim: Grothendieck introduces a 'linear' analogue SM_{ρ,σ}(Ẑ) / SG^±_{ρ,σ}(Ẑ) of the loop-equation group: solutions (α̲,β̲,μ,ε) in GL(2,Ẑ) of the reduced loop equation, with a twisted group law. He also introduces the comparison map from the profinite group to it. This is a modest, possibly unrecorded, explicit construction; its content (the congruence image is essentially controlled by μ) is likely known in spirit.
missed.quote: l'accent ' dans SM_{ρ,σ}(Ẑ)' désigne l'ensemble des systèmes (α̲,β̲,μ,ε,f̲) ... satisfaisant à la relation des lacets
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Gives an explicit 'abelian/linear shadow' of GT through SL_2(Ẑ). This could be compared with work on the GT action on congruence quotients and with linear (e.g. metabelian) approximations of GT. It is probably of limited novelty.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a technical continuation of an explicit computation. It sets up a GT-type group via the loop equation and its reduction to SL_2(Ẑ). The ideas are close to known GT theory, and the linear quotient is unsurprising to specialists.
transcription_corrections: Top page number '493' is Grothendieck's own pagination (archive page 383).
(22) on the image reads (α,β,f) ↦ (u_{α,β,f}, f) or (u_{α,β}, f) (ambiguous); the preceding line has (u_{α,β,f}, f).
The interlinear note likely reads 'dans Gl(2,Ẑ) (pas dans Gl(2,Ẑ)' !)', i.e. the relation is computed before quotienting by ±1, rather than 'Sl(1,Ẑ)''.
